game.title: South Park™: The Fractured But Whole™

roadmap.title: Begin the Mastermind campaign
roadmap.description: Create a Black character with the skin-color slider fully right. Set combat difficulty to Mastermind as soon as control is available. Keep both settings unchanged until The Token Experience unlocks. Collect early costumes, selfies and crafting rewards as you progress to the Randy fight.

roadmap.title: Defeat Professor Chaos
roadmap.description: Continue to The Hundred Hands of Chaos. Use the new TimeFarts for combat challenges, craft different recipes and collect Biohazard materials along the way.

roadmap.title: Finish the campaign on Mastermind
roadmap.description: Explore SoDoSoPa after Professor Chaos, equip four classes, then clear the police station and Mephesto's laboratory. Keep a manual save before Farts of Future Past. Finish the ending and confirm The Token Experience before changing your skin color or difficulty.

roadmap.title: Finish free-roam collections and Morgan Freeman
roadmap.description: Complete the toilet and art checklists with all buddy powers available. Unlock the remaining TimeFart and summons, use every required ally Ultimate and finish your titles. After The Token Experience unlocks, change skin color with PC Principal and challenge Morgan Freeman.

achievements.description: Win a combat by using TimeFart Pause to kill all remaining enemies at once before time resumes
achievements.summary: Finish a battle by killing every remaining enemy within one TimeFart Pause.

steps.text: Leave one enemy alive and reduce that enemy to very low Health.
Activate @mechanic{TimeFart Pause}. Walk up to the last enemy and hit until the enemy dies before the pause ends.

achievements.description: Create a Black character and complete the game on Mastermind Difficulty
achievements.summary: Complete the campaign as a Black character on Mastermind without changing skin color or combat difficulty.

guide.context: A run begun with the wrong skin color requires a new character. Mastermind is a separate combat setting from the skin-color slider.

steps.text: At character creation, move the skin-color slider fully right to create a Black character.
As soon as you control the New Kid, set combat difficulty to @mechanic{Mastermind} in Options. Keep Mastermind if the game asks again during the sixth-grader encounter.
Keep your skin color and combat difficulty unchanged through the ending. Let the credits finish, then confirm the Steam achievement before changing either setting.

achievements.description: Unlock all combat TimeFarts
achievements.summary: Unlock each of the four combat TimeFarts.

steps.text: Progress through the campaign to receive the three story TimeFarts.
Buy the @item{Chocolate Memberito} recipe and a @item{Tortilla} at @loc{Freeman's Tacos}.

After learning Fartkour, speak to Ms. Cartman in her kitchen for @mechanic{Vigilante Marketing}. Give her business cards to the three men at @loc{Skeeter's Wine Bar}, then return for @item{Ms. Cartman's Double Stuffed Brownies}.
Reach Skeeter's roof with Fartkour. Move the dynamite rightward, then set it off to dislodge the fan. Pick up the exposed crank at ground level.
Fit the crank to the berry press on the left side of @loc{Hillvale Farm} to obtain @item{Bucket of Memberberry Juice}.
Craft @item{Chocolate Memberito} with the Tortilla, brownies and juice to gain @mechanic{TimeFart Summon}.

achievements.description: Find 10 costume pieces
achievements.summary: Acquire 10 pieces of costume clothing.

steps.text: Collect costume rewards during story missions. Check the chest in your bedroom for earned clothing.

achievements.description: Craft 10 distinct recipes
achievements.summary: Craft items from 10 different recipes.

steps.text: Use the @mechanic{Crafting} app to make 10 different items from learned recipes. Consumables, costumes and artifacts count; crafting another copy of a used recipe adds no new recipe credit.

achievements.description: Keep an Ally alive for an entire combat while they take twice their max Health in damage
achievements.summary: Win a battle in which one ally survives without being downed after taking damage totaling at least twice that ally's maximum Health.

steps.text: Leave a weak enemy alive beside @npc{Super Craig}. Keep the New Kid and your other allies safe.
Let that enemy damage Craig. Heal Craig with items or Fastpass before Craig falls, until the damage Craig has taken totals twice his maximum Health.
Finish the battle while Craig remains alive.

achievements.description: Obtain and equip Artifacts to reach 600 Might
achievements.summary: Equip artifacts that give a combined Might of at least 600.

steps.text: Open @mechanic{Artifacts} and equip stronger artifacts as new slots become available. Keep upgrading until the equipped total reaches 600 Might.

achievements.description: Equip powers from 2 different classes
achievements.summary: Have powers from two distinct classes equipped simultaneously.

steps.text: After @mechanic{Origins 2: New Beginnings}, open @mechanic{Powers}. Keep a power from your first class and equip a power from the second class.

achievements.description: Pick a fight with Morgan Freeman and defeat him
achievements.summary: Win the optional battle against Morgan Freeman.

guide.context: Morgan Freeman has 9999 Health and refuses to fight a Black New Kid. Changing skin color before the campaign ends can cost The Token Experience.

steps.text: After earning @mechanic{The Token Experience}, visit PC Principal at @loc{Crunchy's Micro Brew} and change to a white skin tone. You can now select Casual combat difficulty.
Stock healing items and Revive Serums. Equip the Plantmancer Ultimate @mechanic{Nature's Gift} for team healing and revivals.
Enter @loc{Freeman's Tacos}, open the passage at the left end of the counter and go behind it. Punch @npc{Morgan Freeman} several times to begin the battle.
Use Callgirl for distant attacks, Mosquito for self-healing and Fastpass for invisibility. Heal and revive throughout the fight, using Nature's Gift when the Ultimate Meter fills.

achievements.description: Loot 100 Biohazard items
achievements.summary: Collect a total of 100 Biohazard crafting materials.

steps.text: Loot toilets, containers and smashed mailboxes as you explore. Keep collecting @item{Biohazard} materials until the total reaches 100.

achievements.description: Craft a macaroni picture for Moses
achievements.summary: Craft a Macaroni Picture for summoning Moses.

steps.text: During @mechanic{A Touch of Faith}, obtain Father Maxi's recipe. Use @item{Macaroni} and @item{Scrap} in the Crafting app to make a @item{Macaroni Picture}.

achievements.description: Reach the highest economic value on your Character Sheet
achievements.summary: Raise the Character Sheet economic rank to the top 0.01%.

guide.context: This rank comes from the bank minigame. The amount of cash you carry does not determine your economic rank.

steps.text: Complete @mechanic{Always Bet on Chaos} at the @loc{Bank of South Park}. Clear the entrance with Toolshed if needed.
Return to the banker and play the portfolio wheel until your economic rank reaches the top 0.01%. Use the wheel's bonuses to recover from bankruptcies and keep advancing.

achievements.description: Become mutual followers with 10 people in South Park
achievements.summary: Gain 10 mutual followers on Coonstagram.

steps.text: Take selfies with 10 different willing characters. Complete a character's request first if that character refuses a selfie.

achievements.description: Successfully Fartkour to the Lofts at SoDoSoPa rooftop and back down again
achievements.summary: Fartkour to the roof of the Lofts at SoDoSoPa and back to ground level.

steps.text: Inspect the pinwheel by the @loc{SoDoSoPa} homeless camp. Use @npc{Human Kite} to Fartkour through the successive jumps to the Lofts rooftop.
Use Human Kite again at the top to Fartkour back down.

achievements.description: Win while 3 Allies are downed at the end of combat
achievements.summary: Win a battle with the New Kid alive and all three allies downed.

guide.context: A defeated Mysterion becomes a ghost, which prevents the required three-ally downed state.

steps.text: Choose three allies other than @npc{Mysterion}. Leave one weakened enemy alive.
Keep the New Kid safe while allowing the enemy to down your three allies. Defeat that enemy with the New Kid before reviving anyone.

achievements.description: Reach the highest rank on 1 title in your Character Sheet
achievements.summary: Reach Master rank in one Character Sheet title.

steps.text: Open @mechanic{Character Sheet → Titles}. Choose a title and complete its displayed requirements until the rank becomes Master.

achievements.description: Wear costume pieces from 3 different sets at once
achievements.summary: Equip head, body and hand costume pieces from three distinct sets.

steps.text: In @mechanic{Costumes}, select a head piece, body piece and hand piece, each belonging to a different costume set.

achievements.description: Foil the plans of Professor Chaos
achievements.summary: Defeat Mecha Minion Chaos Supreme.

steps.text: Defeat @enemy{Mecha Minion Chaos Supreme} at the end of @loc{The Hundred Hands of Chaos}.

achievements.description: Use a Summon
achievements.summary: Activate a combat summon during a battle.

steps.text: Use a @item{Macaroni Picture} from the battle item menu to call @npc{Moses}.

achievements.description: Defeat Mutant Cousin Kyle
achievements.summary: Defeat Mutant Cousin Kyle in Mephesto's laboratory.

steps.text: During @loc{The Many Asses of Dr. Mephesto}, use @mechanic{TimeFart Shift} to change night into day and weaken @enemy{Mutant Cousin Kyle}.
Spread allies across the battlefield to avoid the boss's column attacks. Attack during the daytime windows and complete the final button prompts.

achievements.description: Equip powers from 4 different classes
achievements.summary: Equip four powers, each belonging to a different class.

steps.text: After @mechanic{Origins 4: The Omega Prologue}, assign powers from four distinct classes across your three normal slots and Ultimate slot.
Leave the @mechanic{Powers} screen to register the setup.

achievements.description: Craft an Artifact with a Might value of 75 or more
achievements.summary: Craft an artifact with at least 75 Might.

steps.text: Obtain an artifact recipe rated 75 Might or higher from loot or a vendor. Gather the materials shown in the Crafting app and craft that artifact.

achievements.description: Use TimeFart Glitch to cause a status-effected enemy to lose their turn and die at turn's end
achievements.summary: Kill an enemy with status damage at the end of a turn canceled by TimeFart Glitch.

steps.text: Weaken an enemy and inflict damage over time, such as bleeding, burning or shocked.
When that enemy begins a turn, activate @mechanic{TimeFart Glitch}. The status damage must finish the enemy as the skipped turn ends.

achievements.description: Survive the farts of future past
achievements.summary: Complete the campaign's final mission, Farts of Future Past.

guide.context: If the ending achievement fails to register, reload your pre-mission save and replay the finale.

steps.text: Make a manual save before starting @loc{Farts of Future Past}. Keep that mission selected and finish its final battles and ending.

achievements.description: Defend a helpless child from a drunk lunatic
achievements.summary: Defeat Red Wine Drunk Randy.

steps.text: Defeat @enemy{Red Wine Drunk Randy} during @loc{The Bowels of the Beast}.

achievements.description: Kill an enemy by knocking another enemy into them
achievements.summary: Defeat an enemy with collision damage from another enemy knocked into that target.

steps.text: Line up two enemies and weaken the one at the back. Use a knockback attack on the front enemy so the collision kills the rear enemy.

achievements.description: Reach the highest rank on 5 titles in your Character Sheet
achievements.summary: Reach Master rank in five different Character Sheet titles.

steps.text: Check @mechanic{Character Sheet → Titles} for unfinished requirements. Complete five titles to Master rank as you collect art, master toilets, gather artifacts and win battles.

achievements.description: Confuse or charm an enemy into defeating another enemy
achievements.summary: Make a charmed or confused enemy kill another enemy.

steps.text: Reduce one enemy's Health until another enemy can finish that target.

Use @mechanic{Sweet Scent} from Plantmancer or @npc{Professor Chaos}'s @mechanic{Chaos Confus-O-Tron} on a nearby enemy. Let that charmed or confused enemy land the killing hit on the weakened target.

achievements.description: Acquire and unlock all Summons
achievements.summary: Unlock all four base-game combat summons.

guide.context: Unlocking the summons is sufficient; using each summon is optional.

collectibles.name: Moses
collectibles.method: Complete Father Maxi's story mission to receive the Macaroni Picture recipe.

collectibles.name: Classi
collectibles.method: Finish the police-station story mission to receive Classi's Burner.

collectibles.name: Ned and Jimbo
collectibles.method: Speak to Jimbo about his lost wallet. Pick up the wallet from the table left of the Peppermint Hippo stage, then return it to Jimbo for the Ham Radio.

collectibles.name: Gerald
collectibles.method: Use the camp pinwheel to Fartkour up to Gerald. Give him a Cheesing Vial to unlock his summon.
collectibles.note: Find a Cheesing Vial in SoDoSoPa's red car or Kyle's attic.

achievements.description: Use a toilet and achieve the highest mastery level
achievements.summary: Fully master the minigame at any one toilet.

steps.text: Use the toilet in @loc{your house} at the beginning of the game. Finish all its star stages to earn the green mastery checkmark.

achievements.displayName: Pick Yourself up by Your Bootstraps
achievements.description: Collect all loot in the Homeless Camp at SoDoSoPa
achievements.summary: Collect every loot pickup in the SoDoSoPa homeless camp.

guide.context: The Lofts rooftop is outside the area required for this achievement.

steps.text: Search the camp at ground level, including the couch, containers and spaces behind tents. Collect the loose coins and every other loot prompt.
